interpretation: Approve step 1 only: a labelled sanitized evidence derivative and independent privacy/integrity review. This does not approve the later A2 accounting or numerical implementation steps.
scope: Read the explicitly quarantined original without displaying identifier values; preserve its bytes and owner-only permissions.
Create a separately named sanitized derivative that omits the exact receipt members identified by single-trace-privacy-hold.json, retaining every other member body byte-for-byte.
Use a new exhaustive derivative inventory with explicit original-to-derivative relationships and exclusions. Preserve original manifests as historical records, not current completeness promises.
Test packaging and integrity controls, scan the declared evidence closure, and obtain a fresh independent privacy/integrity review.
Update only bounded publication/progress status after the review; retain every historical failed verdict and all scientific limitations.
acceptance_criteria: The private original digest, size and permissions still match the hold record, and its old repository path remains absent.
Every original member is classified exactly once as retained or explicitly omitted; retained bodies are unchanged; the derivative has a new name and digest and contains no extra members.
No archive extraction is used. Duplicate, escaping or nonregular member entries are refused by the packaging helper; outputs cannot overwrite existing targets.
Omitted receipt bytes and their observed identifier values are not copied to public outputs, logs or review artifacts. Privacy scans report paths, field names and dispositions, not values.
Historical manifests and verdicts remain unchanged, with explicit warnings that original replay closures referencing omitted receipts are incomplete in the derivative.
Meaningful tamper controls reject missing, changed, extra and reintroduced-private members, and a portable copied-artifact verification succeeds.
Independent review binds the exact helper, tests, derivative, inventory, raw check results and protected input manifest.
The numerical source, fixed-trace checker, packet, scientific criteria and resource limits remain byte-identical; no commit, push or release is performed.
independent_review_failure_policy: Preserve the exact reviewed candidate and failed verdict, leave publication on hold and request a decision; this authorization does not restart the exhausted fixed-trace repair loop.
